note: V5 update: renamed api_call_estimates to api_call_base_estimates. These base values assume 'conversation mode' (1 user message = 1 API call). Actual call count is adjusted by user_level, prompt_completeness, model_intelligence, and agent_mode coefficients.

api_call_base_estimates.description: 基础API调用次数范围 [min, max]，基于【对话模式】(用户发一条/模型回一条)。实际调用次数 = 基础值 × 用户经验系数 × 提示词完整度调用系数 × 模型智能度调用系数 × agent模式系数。min对应乐观档位，max对应悲观档位。

static_website.name: 静态网站 (≤5页)
static_website.examples: 个人主页、Landing page、公司简介站
static_website.assumptions: 无后端逻辑，纯HTML/CSS/JS，不使用框架或使用简单静态生成器

blog_content.name: 博客/内容站
blog_content.examples: 技术博客、Markdown内容站、作品集
blog_content.assumptions: 包含MDX/Markdown处理，可能有简单搜索和标签系统

web_app_frontend.name: 前端Web应用
web_app_frontend.examples: 待办事项、仪表盘、社交媒体前端
web_app_frontend.assumptions: 使用React/Vue/Next.js，含状态管理、路由、API对接

web_app_fullstack.name: 带后端的Web应用
web_app_fullstack.examples: 博客+管理后台、小商城、任务管理系统
web_app_fullstack.assumptions: 前后端分离或全栈框架，含数据库、认证

fullstack_complex.name: 全栈+DB+API复杂项目
fullstack_complex.examples: SaaS平台、电商系统、社交网络、企业管理系统
fullstack_complex.assumptions: 多表数据库、复杂业务逻辑、权限系统、文件处理、第三方集成

cli_tool.name: CLI工具
cli_tool.examples: 代码生成器、自动化脚本工具、开发辅助CLI
cli_tool.assumptions: 命令行参数解析、文件操作、可能含模板生成

api_service.name: API服务
api_service.assumptions: 含数据库ORM、认证中间件、输入验证、错误处理

mobile_app.name: 移动应用
mobile_app.assumptions: 含导航、状态管理、原生功能调用、多屏幕适配

chrome_extension.name: 浏览器扩展
chrome_extension.examples: 网页增强工具、开发者工具、自动化插件

skill_plugin.name: AI Skill/Plugin
skill_plugin.examples: Claude Code Skill、Cursor Plugin、自定义Agent工具
skill_plugin.assumptions: 包含SKILL.md、配置、模板文件，通常几百行内容

auth_system.name: 认证系统
auth_system.complexity_notes: 含注册/登录/密码重置/session管理。OAuth集成会额外增加30-50K

payment.name: 支付集成
payment.complexity_notes: Stripe/支付宝/微信支付。含订单管理、退款逻辑、Webhook处理

file_upload.name: 文件上传
file_upload.complexity_notes: 含拖拽上传、预览、格式校验、进度条。云存储集成额外增加30K

search.name: 搜索功能
search.complexity_notes: 全文搜索、筛选、排序。使用Elasticsearch/Algolia时增幅更大

realtime.name: 实时功能
realtime.complexity_notes: WebSocket/SSE、聊天、实时通知、协作编辑

data_viz.name: 数据可视化
data_viz.complexity_notes: 图表、仪表盘、数据报表。使用D3/ECharts等库

i18n.name: 国际化/多语言
i18n.complexity_notes: 含翻译文件管理、RTL布局、日期/货币格式化

third_party_api.name: 第三方API集成（每个）
third_party_api.complexity_notes: 外部API对接、错误处理、重试逻辑、数据转换

admin_panel.name: 管理后台
admin_panel.complexity_notes: CRUD界面、权限管理、数据导出、操作日志

email_notification.name: 邮件通知
email_notification.complexity_notes: 邮件模板、队列发送、退订管理

testing.name: 测试
testing.complexity_notes: 单元测试+集成测试+E2E。覆盖率要求越高，token越多

from_scratch.name: 从零新建
from_scratch.description: 全新项目，无现有代码基础

major_rewrite.name: 大规模改造
major_rewrite.description: 保留少量核心逻辑，大部分代码重写

moderate_modification.name: 中等修改
moderate_modification.description: 添加重要功能或重构部分模块

minor_changes.name: 小改动
minor_changes.description: 添加小功能、优化、修复多个bug

work_types.description: 项目在估算前需要先识别工作类型，不同类型的 modification_factor 适用性不同

standard_feature_dev.name: Standard feature development
standard_feature_dev.description: CRUD, UI components, APIs, auth, integrations with clear specs

code_modification.name: Code modification / refactoring
code_modification.description: Changing existing code structure, logic, or interfaces

skill_plugin_dev.name: Skill / Plugin development
skill_plugin_dev.description: SKILL.md, MCP servers, AI tool plugins

research_content.name: Research-based content creation
research_content.description: Collecting benchmark data, writing documentation, analysis files. modification_factor does NOT apply — this type is always close to full creation cost regardless of whether the project is new or existing.
research_content.note: Always estimate this portion as if from scratch, then add to the rest

mixed.name: Mixed project
mixed.description: Contains both standard development and research/content work
mixed.note: Split into sub-tasks by type, estimate each separately, then sum. Do not apply a single modification_factor to the whole project.

complex_system.name: Complex system architecture
complex_system.description: Microservices, distributed systems, custom infrastructure, multi-service backends
complex_system.warning: Unknowns compound quickly. Estimates may be off by 3x or more.

debug_heavy.name: Debugging-heavy project
debug_heavy.description: Unknown bugs, dependency conflicts, environment issues dominate the work
debug_heavy.warning: Each debug loop is unpredictable. Token consumption can spike without warning.

vague_shifting.name: Vague requirements / shifting direction
vague_shifting.description: Goal keeps changing, requirements not defined upfront
vague_shifting.warning: Estimate resets each time the direction changes.
